content: The wiki has no control info. The "unknown-input" error suggests the button name "left" isn't valid. Let me try raw_input with a keyboard key instead — likely the interact key is a key press (e.g. "e" or space). I'll try a sequence of plausible interact keys while standing on/next to the chest.

args.approach: Chest interact with button 'left' is rejected as unknown-input, so switch to raw keyboard input: stand on the chest tile and press common interact keys (e, space, enter) in sequence to open it.
